sn2.21:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || Atha kho Sivo devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sivo devaputto Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn2.21:2.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || seyyo hoti na pāpiyo || ||
sn2.21:3.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || paññā labbhati nāññato ||
sn2.21:4.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || soka-majjhe na socati || ||
sn2.21:5.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || ñāti-majjhe virocati || ||
sn2.21:6.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || sattā hacchanti suggatiṃ || ||
sn2.21:7.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || sattā tiṭṭhanti sātatan ti || ||
sn2.21:8.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Sivaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya pacchābhāsi || ||
sn2.21:9.1: Sabbhir eva samāsetha || sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ || sataṃ saddhammam aññāya || sabbadukkhā pamuccatīti || ||
